entities.text: Mukesh Kumar Gupta vs State Of M.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Shri B.K. Sharma, P.P. for respondent-State.
Since the applicant has challenged the competency of respondent No. 3, it would be appropriate to hear the respondent No. 3 before considering the matter on the question of admission.

Let show cause notice be issued to the respondent No. 3 to appear before this Court and to show cause his competency to be appointed as Food Analyst under the provisions of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, by ordinary as well as registered AD mode on payment of process fee within a week.
Notice be made returnable within four weeks.
Case be again listed under the same head in the week commencing from 18/04/2016.
Interim relief shall continue till next date of hearing.

(N.K.Gupta) Judge Durgekar*
